versions.changelog:
Initial release of k8s-helper skill.

- Run kubectl commands against any Kubernetes cluster using a user-supplied local file or remote kubeconfig URL.
- Automatically installs kubectl if not present and downloads/caches remote kubeconfigs.
- Supports inspecting, managing, and debugging resources with any kubectl subcommand.
- Flexible configuration via CLI flags or environment variables.
- Cached downloads for kubectl binary and kubeconfig files, with explicit refresh option.
- Cross-platform support (Linux/macOS, amd64/arm64), with secure handling of secrets and error reporting.
